Package io.github._3xhaust.core

Interface Renderer

All Known Implementing Classes:
SwingRenderer
public interface Renderer
Platform-neutral rendering primitive. The framework currently ships a Swing implementation in io.github._3xhaust.platform.swing.SwingRenderer.
